Skills.Name: Rampage: When the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on her turn, the gnoll can take a bonus action to move up to half her speed and make a bite attack.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Content: The gnoll makes two attacks, either with her glaive or her longbow, and uses her Incite Rampage if she can.

Actions.Name: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack
Actions.Content: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 1d4+3 piercing damage.

Actions.Name: Glaive: Melee Weapon Attack:
Actions.Content: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 1d10+3 slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Longbow: Ranged Weapon Attack
Actions.Content: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 1d8+2 piercing damage.

Actions.Name: Incite Rampage (Recharge 5-6):
Actions.Content: One creature the gnoll can see within 30 feet of it can use its reaction to make a melee attack if it can hear the gnoll and has the Rampage trait.

Traits.Name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.Content: While in sunlight, the wight has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.Name: Life Drain
Actions.Content: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature within 5 feet. Failure: 6 (1d8 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken. A Humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a Zombie under the wight's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The wight can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at a time.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Content: The wight makes two attacks, using Necrotic Sword or Necrotic Bow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Life Drain.

Actions.Name: Necrotic Bow
Actions.Content: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

Actions.Name: Necrotic Sword
Actions.Content: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.
